Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Eligibility & Mandatory Documentation The bidder must upload clean, legible copies of the following documents during online technical bi d submission. Failure to provide any of these documents will result in immediate technical rejection: 1.1. Past Performance & Experience Criteria: Documented proof (Work Order, Completion Certificate, or GeM CRAC) confirming the successful supply of similar IT hardware, surveillance equ ipment, or data storage solutions within the last three (03) years to any Central/State Govt Organiz ation / PSU / Public Listed Company. 1.2. Financial Standing: Annual Turnover Certificates for the last three consecutive financial y ears, duly certified by a Chartered Accountant. 1.3. OEM Authorization: A Tender Specific Manufacturer’s Authorization Form (MAF) explicitly referencing this unique GeM Bid Number, issued directly by the respective OEMs (for PCs, Projector, and Networking equipment). It must ensure genuine component sourcing, direct technic al lifecycle support, and include OEM contact details (name, designation, address, e-mail ID, and p hone number) if submitted through an authorized distributor/service provider. 1.4. Make in India (MII): In line with Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) orders, t he bidder must submit a local content percentage certificate specifying the local value addition. 1.5. Statutory Registrations: Valid copies of company PAN and GSTIN. 1.6. Standards Certification: All supplied items must meet relevant national and international

quality and safety standards, including type-approval or testing compliance from the Standardisati on Testing and Quality Certification (STQC) where applicable. 1.7. Onsite Warranty: The entire hardware bundle must carry a minimum of 03 Years Compre hensive Onsite OEM Warranty from the date of final GeM acceptance (CRAC), except where explici tly specified otherwise in the BoQ (e.g., Projector lamp). This includes 100% free parts and labor re placement for all defective components. 1.8. Dedicated Helpdesk: Provision of a dedicated support contact matrix, email, or a service desk line for direct fault logging and escalation. 1.9. Pristine Delivery: All stores must be delivered in pristine, factory-sealed condition directly to the designated consignee location within the stipulated delivery timeline, inclusive of all transit i nsurance and handling charges. 1.10. Hardware Authenticity: Bidders must submit a formal declaration on their official corpor ate letterhead certifying that all supplied IT hardware, processors, memory modules, and storage drives are 100% brand new, original factory-sealed units. 1.11. Malicious Code / Firmware Certificate: A certificate from the OEM/Bidder confirming tha t the system BIOS, storage controllers, and device firmware layers are entirely free from unauthori zed remote access features, backdoors, or embedded tracking exploits. 1.12. Non-Blacklisting Declaration: The bidder must provide a declaration on an INR 100 non- judicial stamp paper issued after the start of the bid date and duly notarized, confirming they have not been debarred or blacklisted by any bid-inviting authority, central/state govt organizations, se mi-govt bodies, PSUs, Defence, or paramilitary forces. 1.13. OEM Support Portal: OEM must have the facility to download updates of software, device drivers, and firmware on its website. Specification and warranty of the offered Model should be available through serial number search/tracking on the website of the OEM. 1.14. Seller Rating: Sellers with good rating ( 4.5) are preferred. Documentary evidence must b e submitted by the bidder. 1.15. Delivery Period: Delivery period for completion of work would be within 15/30 (as per con tract) days of placing the supply order from the effective date of contract. Note that the contract c an be cancelled unilaterally by the buyer in case items are not received within the contract deliver y period. Extension of contracted delivery period will be at the sole discretion of the buyer, within applicability of the LD clause as applicable on the GeM Portal. 2. Mandatory Pre-Bid Interaction & Physical Demonstration :- 2.1. Mandatory Participation & Evaluation: Attendance at the scheduled Pre-Bid meeting is a mandatory prerequisite for the Technical Assessment process. Bidders who fail to attend this inter action will be summarily disqualified, and their bids will be marked as "Technically Non- Responsive." 2.2. Technical Demonstration (Physical Sample): Bidders must bring one physical sample of t he quoted unit for mandatory functional testing and structural evaluation during the pre-bid meeti ng. The committee will verify operational parameters against technical requirements, and failure t o present a working sample will result in immediate disqualification. 2.3. Security Clearance & Operational Security (OPSEC): 2.3.1. Prior Intimation: Due to the restricted military nature of the installation and Statio n Standing Orders, bidders must email the names, valid Government-Issued Photo ID detai ls (such as Voter ID or [Aadhaar Redacted]), scanned copies of the Firm's Authorization Let ter, and vehicle registration numbers of their representatives to dbhaduriya.909m@gov.in at least 48 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. 2.3.2. Electronic Device Ban: Entry of laptops, camera-enabled mobile phones, USB driv es, or any recording/smart devices (including smartwatches) is strictly prohibited within th

e station premises. Bidders are directed to carry hard copies (paper) of their technical pres entations and brochures. Non-compliance will lead to immediate denial of entry. 2.3.3. Agenda of Interaction: Point-by-point verification of the technical specification lay out to align structural understanding and the 03-year comprehensive onsite warranty exec ution framework. 3. We prefer to procure from local vendors due to our remote location, as it significantly complicates th e process of product exchanges and returns with non local suppliers. .
